all.src: Net credit >= 20% of width for 0DTE (lower than the 33% swing rule -- 0DTE credit is thinner, which is why the stop must be tighter).
Max loss per position <= 1% of equity = $500 on $50k. Maximum 3 concurrent 0DTE positions; total 0DTE defined risk <= 3% of equity per day.
Both legs OI >= 1000, bid/ask <= $0.03 on a $1-wide. Submit as one MLeg limit order at the mid; do not chase more than $0.02.

management.src: Take profit at 50% of credit received, or at any point after 15:00 ET where the spread can be closed for <= $0.05.
Stop loss: close at 2.0x the credit received. This is not optional -- 0DTE spreads go from 50% winner to max loss in minutes.
Delta stop: close if the short strike's locally computed delta reaches 0.35.
Touch stop: close immediately if the underlying trades through the short strike, regardless of the spread mark.
Time-decay ratchet: after 15:00 ET, tighten the profit target to 35% of credit -- the remaining theta is not worth the remaining gamma.

exits.src: UNCONDITIONAL FLATTEN AT 15:30 ET. Every 0DTE position, winner or loser, in the money or out, is closed by 15:30 ET. This is the single most important rule in the entire options module.
ASSIGNMENT GUARD: if the short leg is ITM at any time after 15:00 ET, close immediately rather than waiting for the 15:30 sweep.

If a closing limit order is unfilled by 15:40 ET, escalate: reprice to the natural (bid for a sale, ask for a purchase) every 10 seconds until filled. Accept the slippage; it is always cheaper than assignment.

unexpressed.text: LOCAL GREEKS REQUIRED: Alpaca serves no greeks or IV for 0DTE contracts at any subscription tier. Compute IV by inverting Black-Scholes on the option mid, using T = (seconds remaining to 16:00 ET) / (252 * 23400), then compute delta from that IV. Refresh at least every 30 seconds while a position is open. Do not trade this structure if the greeks pipeline is stale by more than 60 seconds.
